executive_summary.headline: Evaluation and evidence are becoming operating infrastructure
executive_summary.body: NIST’s evaluation work and trajectory-assurance research point toward reproducible tests over complete agent runs, while EU rules make disclosure and marking auditable duties.

executive_summary.headline: Industrial AI is being framed as a security and productivity system
executive_summary.body: NIST’s manufacturing and data-center work connects AI adoption to human-in-the-loop systems, infrastructure controls, and measurable outcomes.
